bug_info.bug_desc: The operation tracker tests sha3_done with mubi4_test_false_strict when sha3_absorbed is canonically true. A noncanonical done encoding therefore leaves the tracker in KmacMsgFeed instead of selecting KmacDigest. Canonical true done still takes the higher-priority return-to-idle path.
bug_info.fix_hint: Use mubi4_test_false_loose for the message-feed to digest condition, retaining strict true testing for absorbed and the higher-priority canonical-true done path.
